title: Lane start is claim plus worktree add; lane-run worktree, preflight, git and lane-lock are deleted
body:
Split of S24 (t-x4z168s), step 2 of 3. `krn lane start` keeps only the claim plus `git worktree add`; `gitWith` (src/cli/lane-run/git.ts) and `sleepSync` (src/cli/lane-lock.ts) move to their owners, since src/cli/lane.ts and src/cli/lane-finish.ts import them; `tokenHelper` stays (src/outside-git.ts, doctor-unattended import it).
Outcome: src/cli/lane-run/worktree.ts, preflight.ts, git.ts and src/cli/lane-lock.ts are deleted (434 lines), with scripts/boundaries.ts and their tests updated; lane start, lane finish and ship tests stay green.
Proof: `test ! -e src/cli/lane-lock.ts && test ! -e src/cli/lane-run/preflight.ts` and `npm test` green on CI.
